description: This file contains unit tests for parsing and handling talk mode configuration within the OpenClaw application, testing behaviors such as payload validation, fallback to legacy fields, silence timeout configuration, and default values.

classes.name: TalkModeConfigParsingTests
classes.description: A collection of test functions for verifying parsing logic of talk mode configuration in OpenClaw's Swift codebase.

methods.name: `rejects normalized talk provider payload without resolved`
methods.description: Tests that the selection function rejects a payload lacking the 'resolved' field.

methods.name: `falls back to legacy talk fields when normalized payload missing`
methods.description: Verifies that the system correctly falls back to legacy fields if normalized payload is absent.

methods.name: `reads configured silence timeout ms`
methods.description: Checks that the silence timeout configuration value is correctly read from the payload.

methods.name: `defaults silence timeout ms when missing`
methods.description: Ensures the default silence timeout is used if the value is missing from the payload.

methods.name: `defaults silence timeout ms when invalid`
methods.description: Validates that the system defaults to a standard value when an invalid silence timeout is specified.
